$description: Generated from Dirty Rebirth style v0.4.2 (provisional). Do not edit by hand.

spray-red.$description: Brand accent. The one call to action per screen. Measured from the graffiti red in the key art.

poppy-red.$description: Lighter accent for hover/highlight on red elements.

sky.$description: Cool neutral: secondary text, borders, quiet surfaces.

paper.$description: Primary text on dark; paper/poster surfaces.

muted.$description: The DIMMEST text allowed: secondary values, captions, the legal line. Passes 4.5:1 as rendered on calm dark paper at every window size (check-text-legibility.py; #b3b0a8 read 4.5:1 at 1100x720, too close). Never lower text contrast with opacity - use this.

asphalt-2.$description: Raised surface on the page background.

teal.$description: Rare secondary accent (graffiti throw-ups). Use sparingly.

hazard.$description: World colour for quarantine barriers and warnings ONLY - never a button or brand colour.

display.$description: Headings, button words, labels. The Dirty Bomb voice.

spray.$description: Graffiti accents only (a word or two). Never body text.

body.$description: Body text and UI. Dirty Bomb's own UI font (SIL OFL, safe to bundle and serve). Replaces Inter, the #1 'looks AI-made' tell.

display-public.$description: Public web fallback for the display face only.

smoke-card.$description: The status card on the home screen.

veil.$description: Darkens the art behind every screen except home.

calm-white.$description: TEXT-SAFE wash behind a word printed on white paper: the paper's own colour, sampled from the painted kit. Fades out to the paper's texture at the edges, so specks never sit behind letters.

calm-red.$description: Text-safe wash behind a word on red paper (the sticker, the red strip). Darker than the painted red, so white type clears 4.5:1 as rendered even at the smallest window (#b80a09 measured 4.4:1 at 1100x720).

calm-black.$description: Text-safe wash behind words on black paper (panels, the selected tab). Covers the painted cracks behind text.

calm-strength.$description: Opacity at the centre of a calm wash. The edge is always 0, so the torn paper still shows.

paste-on.$description: Panels arrive like a poster slapped on a wall, then rest a hair crooked.

hover-lift.$description: A button lifts off the wall under the pointer.

art-drift.$description: The key art is never frozen.

rain.$description: Rain beads run down smoke surfaces. Weather only.

glint.$value: one diagonal glint across the element

attention.$description: ONLY on the single element that needs the player right now (e.g. INSTALL/UPDATE when a download is required). Occasional, never constant; stops the moment the player acts; skipped under reduced motion. Owner 2026-09-22: "we need to introduce a hint/glint/shimmer/tutorial/on boarding effect to buttons that are trying to draw the attention of players".

pointer-hint.$description: Onboarding: when an install or update is required, the PLAY poster reads CLICK THIS with a hand-sprayed arrow pointing at the INSTALL/UPDATE sticker. It returns to PLAY once nothing is pending (owner, 2026-09-22).

laser.$description: Kira's orbital laser, always on, roaming slowly around the Dome in the key art. Owner 2026-09-22: "it needs to move slowly".
